139c9013d3.q: What was Google Wave and why was it eventually shut down despite its technological innovation?
139c9013d3.a: Google Wave was a communications product that combined real-time communication, seamless docs, spreadsheets, and chat into one product. Although the underlying technology was incredibly impressive and influenced products like Slack and Google Docs, it was not a great success at launch because people couldn't figure out how to weave it into their day-to-day lives. Eventually the team gave up on it, though its legacy was significant in shaping how people collaborate in real time today.
139c9013d3.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

08c14803e4.q: How did Canva's approach to product launch differ from the lean startup methodology popular at the time?
08c14803e4.a: While The Lean Startup methodology advocated getting products out quickly to learn from users, Canva deliberately spent a year building and testing before launch. Cameron and his co-founders knew they needed to launch a product with a certain level of quality based on their understanding of users from past experience in design and technology. Despite investors constantly telling them to launch, they built something they knew their customers would love, and when they did go live, they had all the signals that people would really like it.
08c14803e4.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

11b8ca13d0.q: What happened when Fluent unexpectedly gained 80,000 users in one day and what were the business consequences?
11b8ca13d0.a: After a journalist published a front-page story about Fluent, 80,000 people descended wanting to use the product in just one day, though the team wasn't ready for the surge. Running the product for all those users would have cost $400,000 in the first month alone, which they didn't have. This forced them to reconsider their bootstrapping strategy and pursue funding, leading to a two-month San Francisco fundraising effort that ultimately didn't land the right investment.
11b8ca13d0.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

b0df007103.q: How many people are currently using Canva and what is Cameron Adams' vision for future growth?
b0df007103.a: Canva currently has 250 million people using the product. Despite all the efforts over 14 years and 5,000 people joining the company, Cameron believes they have only scratched the surface of what Canva can do. He strongly believes that over a billion people should be using it all around the world, and that is what the company is building for.
b0df007103.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

0de72d6641.q: How has Canva integrated artificial intelligence into its product and what was the user response?
0de72d6641.a: Canva has integrated AI across all of its product as a way to enable creativity, help users get started quicker, and assist when they get stuck. The company has had over 30 billion uses of its AI features to date. When they rolled out a major second version of Canva AI earlier this year, it was so popular that they could barely keep up with the demand, forcing them to manage the rollout carefully.
0de72d6641.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

d5b2b13bcf.q: What is Canva's two-step plan and how does the company apply its moral thread beyond shareholder value?
d5b2b13bcf.a: Canva's two-step plan is: step one is to make a valuable company, and step two is to do the most good the company can in the world. This means sending positive ripples all around the world through the product and through the Canva Foundation, which focuses on delivering basic needs and quality education to everyone. Cameron and his wife also joined the Giving Pledge in 2025, committing the majority of their wealth to protecting nature and conserving and regenerating biodiversity around the planet.
d5b2b13bcf.e: From blogger to billionaire, Canva's co-founder on what failures at Google Wave taught him

8e97d682ec.q: What are the four points of the White House AI self-regulation accord announced after Trump's lunch with tech CEOs?
8e97d682ec.a: The four points include internal controls within organizations, staff empowered to oversee implementation, external auditors to review the process, and an independent committee of the board of directors to oversee and receive reports from teams operating the controls and internal and external auditors and evaluators, ensuring any identified issues are remediated. However, this accord is morally binding rather than legally binding.
8e97d682ec.e: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

21da070d5b.q: What did Jacob Coxon say about AI existential risk while working at Anthropic?
21da070d5b.a: Jacob Coxon, who quit Anthropic and previously worked at OpenAI, stated that people deep in the weeds coding AI believe there is a greater than 10 percent chance of human extinction if the current rate of progress continues, and that many foundational researchers believe there is a real possibility of human extinction from AI.
21da070d5b.e: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

f8a46a3726.q: Why does Jensen Huang of NVIDIA reject claims about AI existential risk?
f8a46a3726.a: Jensen Huang stated that the 10 percent existential risk claim is not grounded in science or research, and that just because it comes from a scientist does not make it scientific. He argues that scaring young people about AI threatening their jobs is unhelpful rather than socially good.
f8a46a3726.e: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

b73a3cf492.q: What is the University of Massachusetts poll finding on American public support for AI data centres?
b73a3cf492.a: According to a University of Massachusetts poll, only 11% of Americans support data centres, which form the bedrock of AI infrastructure development.
b73a3cf492.e: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

61a60a4bd9.q: What did China's President Xi say about global AI cooperation at a recent summit?
61a60a4bd9.a: President Xi stated that AI development should not be a solo performance by any one country but rather a symphony of global cooperation, emphasizing the need to strengthen safety guardrails, prevent abuse and malicious use, and ensure AI remains under human control.
61a60a4bd9.e: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

ec68fddb60.q: What is Andrew Bailey's position as Governor of the Bank of England on AI regulation timing?
ec68fddb60.a: Andrew Bailey stated that regulating AI is not the right place to start, and that rigorous testing should come first while the pace of progress must accelerate.

db3c36d16b.q: What housing measures did Spain approve in response to the 87-year-old woman eviction protests in Madrid?
db3c36d16b.a: Spain's government approved new housing measures including a potential ban on evictions until 2030 and a ban on investment firms buying houses. These measures came after an 87-year-old woman was evicted from her home in Madrid, which led to huge protests.

6c799b4640.a: According to the UN, 44% of households globally spend more than 30% of their income on rent, and the world needs around 96,000 additional affordable and accessible homes every single day.

29e1764417.q: Why would a US diesel export ban likely increase gasoline prices rather than lower them?
29e1764417.a: If the US cannot export diesel, refiners cannot get a good price for their diesel and will cut back production. When crude oil is processed, it produces diesel, gasoline, and jet fuel simultaneously. Cutting back production means less of all three products, including gasoline which is politically more sensitive and what most Americans use.

3e46a15dfa.q: How many tiles are in American mahjong compared to Chinese standard mahjong sets?
3e46a15dfa.a: In the United States, mahjong sets have 166 tiles, whereas the standard in China is 140 tiles. This difference requires a completely different manufacturing process because the US does not allow melamine, so American sets must use acrylic instead.
